title: Goethe's merging with Strasbourg Cathedral
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Goethe's merging with Strasbourg Cathedral, about 18th century at Strasbourg Cathedral, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he experienced this merging with the cathedral

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how the German writer Goethe once felt himself merge with Strasbourg Cathedral, drawing on the philosopher Rudolf Steiner and on Goethe's ideas about how we come to know things. Michels uses it as an example of a mind joining with what it looks at, a way of knowing beyond the ordinary senses.
